the futures session

Despite the close of the regular session, significant accumulation was noted in the cash market (NDX) – despite an index decline of -0.34% (price 29622.66), the cumulative CVD energy flow amounted to 54.69 M shares, suggesting passive absorption of supply. The QQQ Dyson Sphere closed the session with a slight loss of -0.30% (price 720.81) with a cumulative flow of 418.35 K.
  • Futures trading (NQ): NQ Probe contracts show relative strength compared to the cash market close, rising by +0.44% to the level of 29869.25. The CVD energy flow on contracts (4.21 K) indicates testing of demand during the evening session.
  • Sentiment and broad market: The flow direction indicator is 30, signaling a moderate advantage of capital inflow. At the same time, the Background Radiation (TICKQ) indicator shows strong selling pressure at the level of -323.00 (with a SMA200 average of 116.39), indicating significant weakness in the Nasdaq broad market after the regular session.
  • QQQ options market: Implied Volatility (IV) is 20.60%, and the Put/Call Volume Ratio at the level of 0.97 suggests a neutral sentiment of market participants (proximity of equilibrium between put and call options). The market-expected range of movement for QQQ lies within the range of 714.04 – 727.70.
